verdict.line: You lose if you sit still and eat poke from level 3-5 while Kennen's energy is full; you win by forcing fights at levels 1-2 and again the moment his E charges run dry.

brief.thesis: Kennen has no mana bar — his kit runs on Energy, and his only kite tool, E (Lightning Rush), is energy-gated and doesn't exist until level 3. Sett's Pit Grit passive fills from any damage taken, including Kennen's poke, so every Q (Thundering Shuriken) that hits you is also charging your own Q (Knuckle Down) and W (Haymaker) faster. The lane hinges on whether Kennen can keep his energy bar topped up to keep dashing away from your grabs.

theirWindow.what: He bounces E through you or a minion to poke-and-reset while chaining autos into 3 stacks of Mark of the Storm for a stun-into-burst combo. Back off the wave and let minions eat stray Q casts instead of walking into them.

yourWindow.when: His energy bar is visibly drained
yourWindow.what: After he's spent E charges kiting or clearing wave, he has no dash left to disengage — walk up immediately and go for the double-target E (Facebreaker) into R (Show Stopper) before his energy regenerates.

start.why: Sustains you through his auto/Q poke while every point of damage taken fills Grit for faster empowered Q procs.

boots.why: Tenacity cuts the stun duration off his passive Mark of the Storm proc and shortens how long his R locks you down in skirmishes; the flat MR blunts his AP poke.

core.why: Sheen proc converts to healing on your first auto per fight, which is exactly the sustain you need in a melee-vs-poke matchup during extended trades.
The move speed and spellblade burst let you actually close the gap on his E dashes instead of eating auto-reset poke all game.
The shield and tenacity keep you alive through his all-in E-Q-auto burst combo once he has items.

situational.when: he's building full AP and out-poking your sustain
their comp stacks additional AP poke or DoT damage beyond just Kennen
their team has a crit or attack-speed carry punishing your engage
you're the primary dive target their team focuses in fights

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the exact playstyle this lane wants — sustained melee trades where your Grit shield and Conqueror's adaptive stacking outlast his hit-and-run poke.

summoners.why: Flash lets you dodge a set-piece Q stun or guarantee a landed R; Teleport resets you onto the wave after his poke shoves you off CS and punishes his frequent roams with his global-ish ultimate.

playing.title: Walk him down levels 1-2
playing.detail: Before E unlocks at level 3, Kennen has zero kite tools. Press auto plus Q (Knuckle Down) trades and shove with minion aggro to deny his CS.

playing.title: Bait Q before engaging
playing.detail: Thundering Shuriken is a slow skillshot with a real cooldown. If he whiffs it or burns it clearing wave, close the gap immediately and start a Grit trade.

playing.title: Track Mark of the Storm stacks
playing.detail: Three stacks stun you outright. At two stacks, disengage instead of eating the auto or Q that completes the combo into his burst.

playing.title: Punish a drained energy bar
playing.detail: After he double- or triple-dashes with E, his energy is tapped and he can't kite your follow-up — engage immediately with E (Facebreaker).

playing.title: Line up the double-target E
playing.detail: Facebreaker's bonus damage and stun need Kennen plus a second body behind him. Position skirmishes so a cannon minion or his jungler is in that line.

playing.title: Time R around his dash charges
playing.detail: Show Stopper telegraphs before it lands. Throw it once his E charges and Flash are both down so he physically can't sidestep the knockback.

playing.title: Build tenacity for his ult window
playing.detail: Slicing Maelstrom stuns every marked target in an AoE during teamfights. Your Mercury's Treads and Sterak's tenacity are what let you keep walking through it to reach his backline.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names drift fast — verify Sundered Sky, Trinity Force, and Sterak's Gage are still live under those names, and recheck Kennen's energy costs on E (Lightning Rush) and the exact Mark of the Storm stack threshold in the current client before locking in this plan.
